inferred_links.I1: SecTime and BeatTime are binary64 members read by the 64-bit branch of the text conversion (type -4 like other double members; 64-bit getters; shipped text matches the 64-bit writer rule). The spec labels this 'Double branch assumed'.
inferred_links.I2: A conversion error while a nested value is read stops the open (same mechanism as the transport-state-v1 refused cases, whose review accepted it).
inferred_links.I3: Nothing between reading the clip and the observation changes its markers or settings. The audio clip's post-read step only links markers (corpus); later steps are untraced. Spec A2 states this premise but scopes it to saved values (plan finding F1).
inferred_links.I4: The sample length used by add_warp_marker is the duration in seconds of the clip's sample. Cases keep at least 0.5 s from the 3 s length.
inferred_links.I5: After its checks pass, an add or remove raises no further error (insert and delete pseudocode contain no throw; callees untraced).
inferred_links.I6: The marker lookup behaves as its corpus pseudocode reads (not dossier-confirmed).
inferred_links.I7: The warped test of the conversions and of the add reflects the IsWarped value read from the document (slot +0x300 target not read in a dossier).
